title: Sales Executive
summary: Front-line sales role representing our partner brands to B2B and B2C customers. No prior experience required and full training is provided.
duties: Make 100 outbound calls daily
Introduce our products and services to potential customers
Qualify leads and book appointments for the Sales Team
Update customer information accurately in the CRM
requirements: Previous telemarketing, sales, customer service, or call center experience is an advantage
Excellent English communication skills
Confident and professional phone etiquette
Reliable internet connection and a quiet WFH setup
Laptop or desktop computer with a headset
Self-motivated and able to meet daily targets

title: App Developer
summary: We are looking for an App Developer who can develop and maintain reliable, user-friendly mobile and web applications while working closely with management on technical solutions and development projects.
duties: Develop and maintain mobile and web applications
Build reliable and user-friendly applications
Translate business requirements into functional technical solutions
Integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services
Test applications and troubleshoot technical issues
Fix bugs and improve application performance
Maintain and improve existing applications
Assist with application deployment and updates
Research new technologies and recommend suitable solutions
Work closely with management on application requirements and development projects
Take ownership of assigned projects from development through completion
requirements: Previous experience in app or software development
Experience with one or more technologies such as Flutter, React Native, Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, or similar
Knowledge of APIs and database integration
Familiarity with Git/GitHub or other version-control systems
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Good communication skills
Strong attention to detail
Portfolio, GitHub profile, or previous projects are highly preferred

title: Finance Manager
summary: We are looking for a Finance Manager who is organised, detail-oriented, responsible, and capable of managing finance operations independently.
duties: Manage daily financial records and transactions
Maintain and update finance trackers
Handle payroll preparation, payslips, and employee-related financial records
Monitor expenses, reimbursements, accounts payable, and receivable
Prepare financial reports and summaries for management
Monitor company cash flow and expenses
Ensure financial records and supporting documents are accurate and organised
Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial records
Coordinate with HR and management on payroll and finance matters
Maintain strict confidentiality of financial information
Improve existing finance processes and reporting systems
Perform other finance-related duties as required
requirements: Previous experience in finance, accounting, bookkeeping, or a related role
Strong knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets
Good understanding of financial and accounting processes
Excellent attention to detail
Strong organisational and time-management skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Good communication and problem-solving skills
Payroll experience is an advantage
Experience working with Singapore-based companies is a plus
